heading: Logical-lifecycle schema declaration
text:
### Logical-lifecycle schema declaration [LNOG.3.1]

A `schema` declaration that uses `scope logical` (or any syntactic
form that maps to the `logical` lifecycle per [LGRA.5.2]) is a
compile error under `logical: false` (`DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_DISABLED`,
[LDIA.3.4.2]), wherever it appears in the compilation unit: in the program or
in any library it imports ([LDIA.2.10.9]).

Rationale: the schema lifecycle is fixed at declaration time and
determines whether the TMS is consulted on retract.  A schema declared
`logical` requires TMS presence; the TMS is absent under `logical: false`.
